title: ‘इनामसँगको’ भाइरल फोटोबारे निश्चल बस्नेत- चिन्नु न जान्नु…
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । विचौलिया भनिएका इनाम सापकोटा अहिले धेरैको चासोमा छन् । पूर्वप्रधानन्याधीश चोलेन्द्रशम्शेर राणालाई पक्राउपछि प्रहरीले उनको मोबाइल जाँच गर्दा इनामसँग संदीग्ध सम्बन्ध रहेको भेटिएको थियो । इनाम को हुन् र उनको पृष्ठभूमि कै हो भन्ने व्यापक कौतुहलबीच सामाजिक सञ्जालमा दुईवटा तस्बिर निकै भाइरल भइरहेका छन् । एउटा भाइरल तस्बिरमा हालका दुई मन्त्री बिराजभक्त श्रेष्ठ र सस्मित पोखरेलसहित केही व्यक्तिहरूको बीचमा बसेका युवक इनाम हुन् भनिएको छ । अर्को तस्बिरमा तीनै व्यक्ति रास्वपा निकट चलचित्र निर्देश निश्चल बस्नेतसँग छन् । सेल्फी तस्बिरमा निश्चलले ती युवकलाई अंकमाल गरेको देखिन्छ । यी दुई तस्बिरले इमान अहिलेकै सत्तानिकट व्यक्ति त होइनन् भन्ने आशंकालाई बल दिएको छ । एमाले नेता सूर्य थापाले त सामाजिक सञ्जालमा उक्त तस्बिर पोस्ट गर्दै इनामलाई सुरुदेखि नै बालेन गिरोहले परिचालित गरेको आरोप लगाएका छन् । उनी लेख्छन्, ‘खासमा ऊ कृत्रिम स्टन्टबाजीको लागि सिर्जित एउटा फेक पात्र मात्रै हो- रसेन्द्र भट्टराईजस्तै । उसलाई शुरूदेखि नै बालेन गिरोहले परिचालित गरेको थियो । झापा-५ मा बालेनको प्रचारप्रसारको लागि काम गरेको उसैले प्रधानमन्त्रीको चाहना भन्दै पछि आएर न्यायाधीशहरूलाई विचाराधीन मुद्दामा अनावश्यक र विवादास्पद चासोका साथ मेसेज पठाएको पाइएको छ ।’ थापा अगाडि लेख्छन्, ‘आमा, बालेन गिरोह नउम्किनेगरी बिचौलियाको घेराबन्दीमा फस्यो, अब यसले देश बनाउने विश्वास र भ्रम दुवै छाडिदिनुहोस् !’ फेसबुक टिप्पणीकार दिलनिशानी मगरले भाइरल तस्बिर राख्दै निश्चल बस्नेतमाथि प्रहार गरेका छन् । उनले लखेका छन्, ‘केपी ओली भाग्न लाग्यो, एयरपोर्टतिर जाऊ भन्ने कलाविहीन नायिकाका निर्देशकहरूको फोटो इनामसँग देखिएको छ । देशका संवेदनशील कागजपत्र बोकेर दिल्ली जान लागेका तिम्रा इनामको बारेमा बोल्न सक्दैनौ । बालेनको नाम लिएर फिल्म चलाउने खुराफाती आइडियाको युग पनि लगभग सकिएको छ । आरजु देउवाको छोराले देश लुट्यो भन्नेहरूलाई देश कब्जा गर्ने इनामका बा-आमा को हुन्, थाहा छैन ।’ मगरको यो स्टाटसपछि निर्देशक बस्नेतले मुख खोलेका छन् । आफूसँग तस्बिरमा देखिएका व्यक्तिलाई आफूले नचिनेको उनको दावी छ । बस्नेतले फेसबुकमा लेखेका छन्, ‘अबदेखि कसैले फोटो खिचौँ न भन्यो भने केही गलत काम गरेको त छैनौँ नि, या भविष्यमा केही गलत त गर्ने वाला त छैनौ नि भनेर सोधेर, बुझेर मात्र फोटो खिच्नुपर्ने भयो । नत्र दिल निशानी सरले नाता जोड्दी हाल्ने रैछन । चिन्नु न जान्नु … ।’ Kathmandu. Inam Sapkota, who is known as a middleman, is currently in the spotlight. After the arrest of former Chief Justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana, the police checked his mobile phone and found that he had a suspicious relationship with Inam. Amidst widespread curiosity about who Inam is and what his background is, two photos are going viral on social media. In one viral photo, the young man is said to be Inam, sitting among some people, including two current ministers Biraj Bhakta Shrestha and Sasmit Pokharel. In the other photo, all three people are with Nischal Basnet, a film director close to the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). In the selfie photo, Nischal is seen hugging the young man. These two photos have strengthened the suspicion that Eman is not a person close to the current government. UML leader Surya Thapa, who posted the photo on social media, accused Eman of being manipulated by the Balen gang from the beginning. He writes, 'In particular, he is just a fake character created for artificial stunts - like Rasendra Bhattarai. He was manipulated by the Balen gang from the beginning. It has been found that he worked for Balen's propaganda in Jhapa-5 and later sent messages to judges with unnecessary and controversial interest in pending cases, claiming to be the Prime Minister's wishes.' Thapa further writes, 'Mother, the Balen gang has been trapped in an inescapable siege by middlemen, now let go of both the belief and illusion that it will build the country!' Facebook commentator Dilnishani Magar has attacked Nischal Basnet by posting a viral photo. He wrote, 'KP Oli is running away, the director's photo of the artless actress who is going to the airport has been seen with Inam. We cannot talk about your Inam who is going to Delhi carrying sensitive documents of the country. The era of the superstitious idea of making a film using Balen's name is almost over. Those who say that Arju Deuba's son has looted the country do not know who the parents of Inam who took over the country are.' Director Basnet has spoken out after Magar's status. He claims that he does not know the person in the photo with him. Basnet wrote on Facebook, 'From now on, if someone asks us to take a photo, we should ask them if we have done anything wrong, or if we are not going to do anything wrong in the future, and take a photo only after understanding. Otherwise, Dil Nishan Sir will continue to establish relationships. Whether we know or not...'

Inam Sapkota, who is known as a middleman, is currently in the spotlight. After the arrest of former Chief Justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana, the police checked his mobile phone and found that he had a suspicious relationship with Inam. Amidst widespread curiosity about who Inam is and what his background is, two photos are going viral on social media. In one viral photo, the young man is said to be Inam, sitting among some people, including two current ministers Biraj Bhakta Shrestha and Sasmit Pokharel. In the other photo, all three people are with Nischal Basnet, a film director close to the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). In the selfie photo, Nischal is seen hugging the young man. These two photos have strengthened the suspicion that Eman is not a person close to the current government. UML leader Surya Thapa, who posted the photo on social media, accused Eman of being manipulated by the Balen gang from the beginning. He writes, 'In particular, he is just a fake character created for artificial stunts - like Rasendra Bhattarai. He was manipulated by the Balen gang from the beginning. It has been found that he worked for Balen's propaganda in Jhapa-5 and later sent messages to judges with unnecessary and controversial interest in pending cases, claiming to be the Prime Minister's wishes.' Thapa further writes, 'Mother, the Balen gang has been trapped in an inescapable siege by middlemen, now let go of both the belief and illusion that it will build the country!' Facebook commentator Dilnishani Magar has attacked Nischal Basnet by posting a viral photo. He wrote, 'KP Oli is running away, the director's photo of the artless actress who is going to the airport has been seen with Inam. We cannot talk about your Inam who is going to Delhi carrying sensitive documents of the country. The era of the superstitious idea of making a film using Balen's name is almost over. Those who say that Arju Deuba's son has looted the country do not know who the parents of Inam who took over the country are.' Director Basnet has spoken out after Magar's status. He claims that he does not know the person in the photo with him. Basnet wrote on Facebook, 'From now on, if someone asks us to take a photo, we should ask them if we have done anything wrong, or if we are not going to do anything wrong in the future, and take a photo only after understanding. Otherwise, Dil Nishan Sir will continue to establish relationships. Whether we know or not...'

सम्बन्ध रहेको भेटिएको थियो । इनाम को हुन् र उनको पृष्ठभूमि कै हो भन्ने व्यापक कौतुहलबीच सामाजिक सञ्जालमा दुईवटा तस्बिर निकै भाइरल भइरहेका छन् । एउटा भाइरल तस्बिरमा हालका दुई मन्त्री बिराजभक्त श्रेष्ठ र सस्मित पोखरेलसहित केही व्यक्तिहरूको बीचमा बसेका युवक इनाम हुन् भनिएको छ । अर्को तस्बिरमा तीनै व्यक्ति रास्वपा निकट चलचित्र निर्देश निश्चल बस्नेतसँग छन् । सेल्फी तस्बिरमा निश्चलले ती युवकलाई अंकमाल गरेको देखिन्छ । यी दुई तस्बिरले इमान अहिलेकै सत्तानिकट व्यक्ति त होइनन् भन्ने आशंकालाई बल दिएको छ । एमाले नेता सूर्य थापाले त सामाजिक सञ्जालमा उक्त तस्बिर पोस्ट गर्दै इनामलाई सुरुदेखि नै बालेन गिरोहले परिचालित गरेको आरोप लगाएका छन् । उनी लेख्छन्, ‘खासमा ऊ कृत्रिम स्टन्टबाजीको लागि सिर्जित एउटा फेक पात्र मात्रै हो- रसेन्द्र भट्टराईजस्तै । उसलाई शुरूदेखि नै बालेन गिरोहले परिचालित गरेको थियो । झापा-५ मा बालेनको प्रचारप्रसारको लागि काम गरेको उसैले प्रधानमन्त्रीको चाहना भन्दै पछि आएर न्यायाधीशहरूलाई विचाराधीन मुद्दामा अनावश्यक र विवादास्पद चासोका साथ मेसेज पठाएको पाइएको छ ।’ थापा अगाडि लेख्छन्, ‘आमा, बालेन गिरोह नउम्किनेगरी बिचौलियाको घेराबन्दीमा फस्यो, अब यसले देश बनाउने विश्वास र भ्रम दुवै छाडिदिनुहोस् !’ फेसबुक टिप्पणीकार दिलनिशानी मगरले भाइरल तस्बिर राख्दै निश्चल बस्नेतमाथि प्रहार गरेका छन् । उनले लखेका छन्, ‘केपी ओली भाग्न लाग्यो, एयरपोर्टतिर जाऊ भन्ने कलाविहीन नायिकाका निर्देशकहरूको फोटो इनामसँग देखिएको छ । देशका संवेदनशील कागजपत्र बोकेर दिल्ली जान लागेका तिम्रा इनामको बारेमा बोल्न सक्दैनौ । बालेनको नाम लिएर फिल्म चलाउने खुराफाती आइडियाको युग पनि लगभग सकिएको छ । आरजु देउवाको छोराले देश लुट्यो भन्नेहरूलाई देश कब्जा गर्ने इनामका बा-आमा को हुन्, थाहा छैन ।’ मगरको यो स्टाटसपछि निर्देशक बस्नेतले मुख खोलेका छन् । आफूसँग तस्बिरमा देखिएका व्यक्तिलाई आफूले नचिनेको उनको दावी छ । बस्नेतले फेसबुकमा लेखेका छन्, ‘अबदेखि कसैले फोटो खिचौँ न भन्यो भने केही गलत काम गरेको त छैनौँ नि, या गिरोह नउम्किनेगरी बिचौलियाको घेराबन्दीमा फस्यो, अब यसले देश बनाउने विश्वास र भ्रम दुवै छाडिदिनुहोस् !’ फेसबुक टिप्पणीकार दिलनिशानी मगरले भाइरल तस्बिर राख्दै निश्चल बस्नेतमाथि प्रहार गरेका छन् । उनले लखेका छन्, ‘केपी ओली भाग्न लाग्यो, एयरपोर्टतिर जाऊ भन्ने कलाविहीन नायिकाका निर्देशकहरूको फोटो इनामसँग देखिएको छ । देशका संवेदनशील कागजपत्र बोकेर दिल्ली जान लागेका तिम्रा इनामको बारेमा बोल्न सक्दैनौ । बालेनको नाम लिएर फिल्म चलाउने खुराफाती आइडियाको युग पनि लगभग सकिएको छ । आरजु देउवाको छोराले देश लुट्यो भन्नेहरूलाई देश कब्जा गर्ने इनामका बा-आमा को हुन्, थाहा छैन ।’ मगरको यो स्टाटसपछि निर्देशक बस्नेतले मुख खोलेका छन् । आफूसँग तस्बिरमा देखिएका व्यक्तिलाई आफूले नचिनेको उनको दावी छ । बस्नेतले फेसबुकमा लेखेका छन्, ‘अबदेखि कसैले फोटो खिचौँ न भन्यो भने केही गलत काम गरेको त छैनौँ नि, या भविष्यमा इनाम को हुन् र उनको पृष्ठभूमि कै हो भन्ने व्यापक कौतुहलबीच सामाजिक सञ्जालमा दुईवटा तस्बिर निकै भाइरल भइरहेका छन् । एउटा भाइरल तस्बिरमा हालका दुई मन्त्री बिराजभक्त श्रेष्ठ र सस्मित पोखरेलसहित केही व्यक्तिहरूको बीचमा बसेका युवक इनाम हुन् भनिएको छ । अर्को तस्बिरमा तीनै व्यक्ति रास्वपा निकट चलचित्र निर्देश निश्चल बस्नेतसँग छन् । सेल्फी तस्बिरमा निश्चलले ती युवकलाई अंकमाल गरेको देखिन्छ ।

Kathmandu. Inam Sapkota, who is known as a middleman, is currently in the spotlight. After the arrest of former Chief Justice Cholendra Shumsher Rana, the police checked his mobile phone and found that he had a suspicious relationship with Inam. Amidst widespread curiosity about who Inam is and what his background is, two photos are going viral on social media. In one viral photo, the young man is said to be Inam, sitting among some people, including two current ministers Biraj Bhakta Shrestha and Sasmit Pokharel. In the other photo, all three people are with Nischal Basnet, a film director close to the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). In the selfie photo, Nischal is seen hugging the young man. These two photos have strengthened the suspicion that Eman is not a person close to the current government. UML leader Surya Thapa, who posted the photo on social media, accused Eman of being manipulated by the Balen gang from the beginning. He writes, 'In particular, he is just a fake character created for artificial stunts - like Rasendra Bhattarai. He was manipulated by the Balen gang from the beginning. It has been found that he worked for Balen's propaganda in Jhapa-5 and later sent messages to judges with unnecessary and controversial interest in pending cases, claiming to be the Prime Minister's wishes.' Thapa further writes, 'Mother, the Balen gang has been trapped in an inescapable siege by middlemen, now let go of both the belief and illusion that it will build the country!' Facebook commentator Dilnishani Magar has attacked Nischal Basnet by posting a viral photo. He wrote, 'KP Oli is running away, the director's photo of the artless actress who is going to the airport has been seen with Inam. We cannot talk about your Inam who is going to Delhi carrying sensitive documents of the country. The era of the superstitious idea of making a film using Balen's name is almost over. Those who say that Arju Deuba's son has looted the country do not know who the parents of Inam who took over the country are.' Director Basnet has spoken out after Magar's status. He claims that he does not know the person in the photo with him. Basnet wrote on Facebook, 'From now on, if someone asks us to take a photo, we should ask them if we have done anything wrong, or if we are not going to do anything wrong in the future, and take a photo only after understanding. Otherwise, Dil Nishan Sir will continue to establish relationships. Whether we know or not...'
